items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Yes. Barney Bigard and Russell Procope, Jimmy Hamilton.

ctx.x: Really, he sure is. And Ellington had some great clarinet players in his band himself.
Yes. Barney Bigard and Russell Procope, Jimmy Hamilton.
I see you know your clarinet history really well. So when you come over to the states, do you try to bring musicians with you?
